# Sprout Social cuts 20% of workforce in restructuring plan
Author [Frank DeMatteo](https://www.investing.com/members/contributors/254843850)
[Stock Markets](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news)
Published07/15/2026, 09:11 AM
Sprout Social cuts 20% of workforce in restructuring plan
View all comments (0) 0

...

Investing.com -- Sprout Social began notifying employees on Tuesday about a workforce reduction that will eliminate approximately 260 positions, or 20% of its staff. The company’s board approved the restructuring plan on July 8, 2026.
The social media management company said the plan aims to streamline its organizational structure and align costs with strategic priorities, including ongoing investments in AI-powered social intelligence.
Sprout Social estimates it will incur pre-tax restructuring charges between $18.0 million and $20.0 million related to the workforce reduction. The charges will consist primarily of cash expenditures for employee severance payments and benefits.
The company expects to recognize substantially all of these charges in the third quarter of 2026. Sprout Social plans to complete the restructuring by the end of the third quarter, subject to local law and consultation requirements.
